'''Krispus Eleaor''' was a [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashi]]. Eleaor founded [[Eleaor Propulsion]], a company that produced customized luxury vehicles.<ref name="TotJC" />
